verdict.rationale: Belvo's API reference lists an Enrichment API with Incomes, Recurring Expenses, Risk Insights and Employment Metrics endpoints. These directly name income and recurring-stream signals, and Belvo separately offers income and employment verification with per-employer salary history. The evidence is only section titles and marketing lines, so the depth of these signals is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of how incomes and recurring streams are derived from connected-account transactions, explicit payroll-deposit detection, output fields or examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform derives income and cash-flow signals from connected accounts — recurring streams, payroll detection, or documented income verification products built on the same data
